<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1043
Claimant:
Keith Mcmahon
Adjuster:
Alison Sweeney
01/29/2025
Claim opened after the policyholder reported a collision at an intersection while turning left across oncoming traffic.
The claimant, who is not represenetd by an attorney, gave a first account by phone and said they felt neck pain
shortly afterward.
02/06/2025
Reviewed the driver's information and confirmed that the driver is named on the polciy and the coverage was active at
the time of loss. Nothing in the file suggests the damage happened before the coverage started.
02/10/2025
Photos submitted by the claimant show damage to the front of the vehicle that is consistent with the described impact.
No earlier damage to the vehicle is known from prior claims or inspection records.
03/11/2025
Spoke with the claimant about seating position at the time of impact. The claimant's recollection on this point is not
fully clear, and it is not certain whether they were in the driver's seat or the front passenger seat during the collision.
04/28/2025
Requested medical records. The claimant reports whiplash-type symptoms, and the reported injury is plausible for a
crash of this type. No earlier injury to the same body area is known from the records available so far.
05/05/2025
Reviewed the photos again. They confirm some details of the scene and the vehicle position, but no independent
witnesses have come forward to describe the collision.
06/14/2025
The claimant contacted the office to add a few small details about traffic conditions and the timing of the turn. The
core account has stayed the same across each conversation.
08/04/2025
Treatment followed a usual course, with physical therapy and periodic check-ins. Symptoms have improved steadily,
and the treatment has tapered off as expected for this type of injury.
08/14/2025
Confirmed with the treating provider that the latest visit notes show reduced neck pain and improved range of motion.
No new complaints were recorded at the most recent appointment.
08/16/2025
Based on the current file, the claim appears consistent with the reported loss, the vehicle damage, and the injury
course. Remaining open items are the final treatment summary and the claimant's signed statement.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
